belief_statement: Preliminary evidence indicates that meridional scheme spherical weno has inconsistent effects on eoc error. The evidence base (9 findings, 1 studies) is growing but not yet conclusive.

mechanisms.pathway: meridional scheme spherical weno → [unknown mechanism] → eoc error

latent_variables.name: Dose and duration
latent_variables.rationale: Most studies measure presence/absence of meridional scheme spherical weno, not dose-response curves. Duration and intensity likely matter.

research_needs.question: Does the effect of meridional scheme spherical weno on eoc error replicate in a pre-registered RCT?
research_needs.rationale: Current confidence is moderate. A well-powered pre-registered replication would most efficiently resolve the status of this belief.
